Did you know our world is full of cool types of things?
There are 4 main blood types – A, B, AB, and O.
Stars come in different sizes and colors like red, yellow, and blue.
We have 3 kinds of rocks – igneous, sedimentary, and metamorphic.
And natural calamities like earthquakes, floods, and cyclones show nature's power!
